evidence_item: Computed pairwise/star alignment to 6 reference GCs (this work)
claim_tested: ODR-1 carries all 6 class III catalytic residues
key_finding: ODR-1 has Gln844 and Glu888 where GC-A has Asp877/Asp921; Glu884, Cys956, Asn963, Arg967 intact (4/6)
context: C. elegans sequence B1Q257 vs rat/human/Chlamydomonas GCs
confidence_and_limits: high for residue identity; alignment-based, no structure

evidence_item: Same analysis applied to DAF-11 Q8I4N4
key_finding: Asp770/Asp814 intact; Ala882, Ile889, Lys893 replace Cys/Asn/Arg (2/6, metal half only)

evidence_item: Internal control: human AC5 C1/C2 (O95622) and sGC alpha1/beta1 (Q02108/Q02153)
claim_tested: Column assignment reproduces known complementary degeneracy
key_finding: AC5 C1 keeps Asp474/Asp518 and loses Asn/Arg; C2 keeps Asn1204/Arg1208 and loses the Asp pair; sGC beta1 Gly426, alpha1 Thr602/Lys606

evidence_item: Alignment robustness scan (4 references x 3 gap settings x 2 queries)
claim_tested: The ODR-1 and DAF-11 calls are not alignment artifacts
key_finding: 24/24 rows concordant; same residues called at all six columns

evidence_item: Family scan of 33 C. elegans cyclase-domain proteins
claim_tested: Complementary degeneracy is a recurring design in this family
key_finding: 21/33 are 6/6 complete; odr-1, gcy-27, gcy-33 lack the metal Asp pair; daf-11, gcy-31, gcy-32, gcy-34, gcy-37, gcy-11 lack substrate/TS residues
confidence_and_limits: high for sequence, inference for pairing

evidence_item: PMID 19323996 (GCY-31/GCY-33 obligate pair in BAG neurons)
claim_tested: Complementary half-sites predict obligate heterodimers in vivo
key_finding: GCY-31 and GCY-33 are each required for BAG CO2 responses; our scan shows GCY-31 lacks substrate/TS residues and GCY-33 lacks the metal Asp pair

evidence_item: Orthologue scan (C. brenneri G0MAD0, C. briggsae A8X4S9, C. remanei C3U4S0, M. incognita A0A386R2C5)
claim_tested: The ODR-1 Gln/Glu substitution is not a gene-model error
key_finding: All four orthologues carry Gln/Glu at the two metal columns

claim_tested: The substituted positions are confidently modelled, not disordered loops
key_finding: ODR-1 cyclase domain mean pLDDT 92.5; Gln844 pLDDT 96.9, Glu888 92.0. DAF-11 domain 88.8

evidence_item: AlphaFold model numbering (1067 aa) vs current UniProt (1047 aa)
claim_tested: The published E904A maps onto the guanine-specifying Glu
key_finding: Offset is exactly +20; model residue 904 is the Glu that is 884 in current numbering
confidence_and_limits: high for the arithmetic; the original paper's reference sequence is inferred

evidence_item: PMID 10774726 (Coburn and Bargmann / L'Etoile and Bargmann era ODR-1 work)
key_finding: Basis of the GO:0097730 cilium IDA annotation for ODR-1
confidence_and_limits: high for localization, says nothing about catalysis

claim_tested: The only EXP-coded support for DAF-11 GC activity
key_finding: Whole-animal LC-MS/MS cGMP quantification in mutants, not a purified enzyme assay

claim_tested: GO:0004383 on ODR-1 has no experimental support
key_finding: Only ISS (donors human NPR1 P16066 and GCY-12 Q19187), IBA (GO_REF:0000033) and IEA; no EXP/IDA/IMP

evidence_item: PubMed searches for ODR-1/DAF-11 physical interaction or reconstitution
claim_tested: No direct biochemical evidence either way
key_finding: No papers found reporting co-IP, reconstitution or in vitro cyclase assay for ODR-1
confidence_and_limits: high that the search returned nothing; absence of evidence
